title: Squintum Dramatic Club (continued) — The Bell and Membership Roll
text:
The first public appearance was on December 22, 1890. Receipts were $7.00. The program was repeated the next night by request. The receipts then were $12.50. The proceeds "so empty lunches"[?] was entered as the official record in the minutes.

On January 15, 1891 an order was placed for a "200 pound bell." This was received on February 10 and presented to the school authorities on February 13, 1891. The presentation was made by Pinkney E. Durrett, treasurer, in the absence of Eldridge K. Norsworthy, manager. The inscription on the bell read:

1891
Presented to Savoy College
By The Squintum Club
E. K. Norsworthy, M'g'r.
Gus W. Thomasson, Sec.
Pinkney E. Durrett, Treas.

While the number of active members was limited to the needs of individual plays, and never exceeded twenty at any one time, the enrollment was much larger, due to the ever changing conditions of a voluntary organization. The following is a transcript of the roll of membership covering the entire period of the life of the club:

J. Washington Alderson, Miss Stella Anderson, Horace H. Arterberry, Mrs. H. H. (Sammie Squires) Arterberry, Miss Lizzie Beauford, Miss Jennie Chenoweth, Virgil R. Conway, Miss Irene Davis, Will H. Davis, W. F. Dodd, Miss Pinkney E. Durrett[?], Little Miss Susie Durrett, Thomas C. Frank, J. L. Hicks, Claude C. Hodge, Miss Bell Huddleston, Will H. Hughes, Allie G. Hughes, Miss Julia Hunt, Miss Judith Hunnicutt, Mrs. M. L. Hunter, Master Edwin Hunter, Miss Jennie Lacy, B. Frank Mayo, Mr. Mitchell Mayo, Edward Anderson McMahon, Miss Florrah Mayo, Pinkney McMahon, Mrs. F. (Sallie Durrett) McQueen, Miss Laura McQueen, Robert F. Naylor, Henry (Harry) Naylor, Eldridge K. Norsworthy, E. Denice Roberts, Charlie M. Sudduth, William F. Sudduth, Mrs. James E. Squires, Gus W. Thomasson, Miss Bertha Thompson, Miss Veda Thompson, Will T. Williamson and W. A. Wilson.
notes: Records the 200-pound bell ordered Jan 1891, presented Feb 13, 1891, with its inscription; followed by the full membership roll of the club. Some names uncertain at scan resolution.
